text_block_list.name: Infirmary Nurse
text_block_list.text:
—For the time being, you'll need to focus on rehabilitation.
I'll call a car so we can have the hospital examine you, just to be safe.

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Even though your growth phase has begun, your body is still developing.
If you push yourself too hard, it takes a toll immediately. ...You understand, right?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Good girl. Don't worry. With proper rehab,
you'll be back to training before you know it. For now, take it easy, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During the horsegirls' practice hours, I spotted Nishino Flower.
...Seeing the way she favored one leg, I immediately realized she was injured.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer...
I-I... after all that, I was supposed to... give you courage...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: And yet... I...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...I-I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tears welling in her eyes, Nishino Flower turned and ran.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Running on an injured leg...!
Filled with worry, I chased after her at once.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pursuing her small silhouette, I arrived at a certain spot.
And there—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A breathtaking expanse of vibrant, gorgeous blossoms colored the scene.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...You came after me.
I'm sorry for running away...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...my favorite place.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I look at flowers, they always encourage me.
They make me want to try even harder.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No matter how small a flower is, just seeing it bloom gives me courage.
That's why... I wanted to be like that, too. That's why I came here.

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Watching you run, Flower, somehow filled me with confidence.
After all, our greatest treasure is shining so brightly."

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text:
Yes, exactly. We got so much courage from you.
We realized there's no need to shrink away—we should hold our heads high.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Because the people I hold dear told me that I gave them courage.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Mmh! In that case, let us have a rematch!
This time, I shall demonstrate a decisive, flawless victory!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Flowers dance in the wind, so to keep them from blocking my view,
I must become the wind myself, mustn't I?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Even when the gap between us crushed me, I still wanted to do my best.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
…And yet, I ended up getting hurt.
I knew… I knew I shouldn't have pushed myself that recklessly, and yet…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm still just a kid, but… *sob*, if I just try… *hic*,
I didn't want everyone to leave me behind… I… I just…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to make my dream… come true… *sniff*, ah…
…*sob*, uwaaah…!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower weeps, her frail shoulders trembling.
She must be so frustrated by her own perceived inadequacy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It would be easy to simply tell her that's not true.
Yet more than that, the feeling welling up inside me right now is—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm so… sor… ry… I'm just so…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh…?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once more, I tell Nishino Flower.
How watching her had encouraged me, how it had saved me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That is why her dream can come true. We can make it happen.
She can become a blooming flower not just for me, but for so many people.
choice_data_list: You don't want to give up on your dream, do you?
You don't want to give up on your dream, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she truly wanted to give up, she wouldn't have come here.
In front of the flowers that give her encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list: Please let me help you reach your dream.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
…I… I don't want to give up…!
No, I haven't given up!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Because… you really got courage from me, right?
From me… truly…?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
…Thank… thank you so much…!
I'll do my very best… so, please!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a smile back on Nishino Flower's face, we head back to the academy.
Starting tomorrow, we'll join hands and run toward our dream together.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Well then, thank you so much for today.
I'll head back to the classroom now.
choice_data_list: With your leg and all, maybe visit the infirmary first…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I can manage that by myself, so please don't worry.
You already had to run around for me, Trainer, so I can't trouble you any further…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh-ho, Flower, you going to the nurse's office too? Make sure you leave
a bed for Sei-chan, 'kay? I was just craving a nice nap. *yaaaawn*…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Sky-san? …You're going to sleep in the infirmary?
That's rare. You usually take naps outside whenever it's sunny…

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Gotta mix it up sometimes," Seiun Sky says with a nonchalant face.
Yet for just a split second, her gaze glances down at Nishino Flower's leg—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hmm-mm? Whatever could you mean~?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Sky-san, please wait up!
Well then, Trainer, see you tomorrow…!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky waves her hand lazily as she ambles along.
I watch with a warm heart as Nishino Flower matches her pace.
